name: double
type: Nat → Nat
doc: Doubles a number.
source:
/-- Doubles a number. -/
def double : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => double n + 2

name: double_eq
type: ∀ (n : Nat), double n = 2 * n
source:
theorem double_eq (n : Nat) : double n = 2 * n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp [double]
    omega
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp [double]
    omega

name: Bad_Name

name: uses_open

source: theorem uses_open (n : Nat) : n + 0 = n := open_one n

name: Maithic.Algo.insertSorted
type: {α : Type u} → [inst : LE α] → [DecidableLE α] → α → List α → List α
doc: Inserts `x` in front of the first element that is not smaller than it.
source:
/-- Inserts `x` in front of the first element that is not smaller than it. -/
def insertSorted (x : α) : List α → List α
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: insertSorted x ys
proof:
| [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: insertSorted x ys

name: Maithic.Algo.insertionSort
type: {α : Type u} → [inst : LE α] → [DecidableLE α] → List α → List α
doc: Insertion sort.
source:
/-- Insertion sort. -/
def insertionSort : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => insertSorted x (insertionSort xs)

name: Maithic.Algo.mem_insertSorted
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] {x z : α} {l : List α},
  z ∈ Maithic.Algo.insertSorted x l ↔ z = x ∨ z ∈ l
doc: Inserting adds exactly the new element.
source:
/-- Inserting adds exactly the new element. -/
theorem mem_insertSorted {x z : α} {l : List α} : z ∈ insertSorted x l ↔ z = x ∨ z ∈ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [insertSorted]
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [insertSorted]
    split
    · simp
    · simp only [List.mem_cons, ih]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h | h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
      · rintro (h | h | h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [insertSorted]
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [insertSorted]
    split
    · simp
    · simp only [List.mem_cons, ih]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h | h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
      · rintro (h | h | h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)

name: Maithic.Algo.insertSorted_perm
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] (x : α) (l : List α),
  (Maithic.Algo.insertSorted x l).Perm (x :: l)
doc: Inserting into a list gives a permutation of the list with the element in front.
source:
/-- Inserting into a list gives a permutation of the list with the element in front. -/
theorem insertSorted_perm (x : α) (l : List α) : (insertSorted x l).Perm (x :: l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [insertSorted]
    split
    · exact List.Perm.refl _
    · exact (List.Perm.cons y ih).trans (List.Perm.swap x y ys)
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [insertSorted]
    split
    · exact List.Perm.refl _
    · exact (List.Perm.cons y ih).trans (List.Perm.swap x y ys)

name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_insertSorted
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] [Maithic.Algo.TotalPreorder α] (x : α)
  {l : List α}, Maithic.Algo.Sorted l → Maithic.Algo.Sorted (Maithic.Algo.insertSorted x l)
doc: Inserting into a sorted list keeps it sorted.
source:
/-- Inserting into a sorted list keeps it sorted. -/
theorem sorted_insertSorted [TotalPreorder α] (x : α) {l : List α} (h : Sorted l) :
    Sorted (insertSorted x l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [insertSorted]
  | cons y ys ih =>
    have hy := sorted_cons.mp h
    simp only [insertSorted]
    split
    · rename_i hxy
      refine sorted_cons.mpr ⟨?_, h⟩
      intro z hz
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hxy
      · exact TotalPreorder.le_trans _ _ _ hxy (hy.1 z hz)
    · rename_i hxy
      have hyx : y ≤ x := (TotalPreorder.le_total x y).resolve_left hxy
      refine sorted_cons.mpr ⟨?_, ih hy.2⟩
      intro z hz
      rcases mem_insertSorted.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hyx
      · exact hy.1 z hz
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [insertSorted]
  | cons y ys ih =>
    have hy := sorted_cons.mp h
    simp only [insertSorted]
    split
    · rename_i hxy
      refine sorted_cons.mpr ⟨?_, h⟩
      intro z hz
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hxy
      · exact TotalPreorder.le_trans _ _ _ hxy (hy.1 z hz)
    · rename_i hxy
      have hyx : y ≤ x := (TotalPreorder.le_total x y).resolve_left hxy
      refine sorted_cons.mpr ⟨?_, ih hy.2⟩
      intro z hz
      rcases mem_insertSorted.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hyx
      · exact hy.1 z hz

name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_insertionSort
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] [Maithic.Algo.TotalPreorder α] (l : List α),
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted (Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l)
doc: The output of insertion sort is sorted.
source:
/-- The output of insertion sort is sorted. -/
theorem sorted_insertionSort [TotalPreorder α] (l : List α) : Sorted (insertionSort l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact sorted_nil
  | cons x xs ih => exact sorted_insertSorted x ih
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact sorted_nil
  | cons x xs ih => exact sorted_insertSorted x ih

name: Maithic.Algo.insertionSort_perm
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] (l : List α),
  (Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l).Perm l
doc: The output of insertion sort is a permutation of its input.
source:
/-- The output of insertion sort is a permutation of its input. -/
theorem insertionSort_perm (l : List α) : (insertionSort l).Perm l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | cons x xs ih => exact (insertSorted_perm x _).trans (List.Perm.cons x ih)
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | cons x xs ih => exact (insertSorted_perm x _).trans (List.Perm.cons x ih)

name: Maithic.Algo.length_insertionSort
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] (l : List α),
  (Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l).length = l.length
doc: Insertion sort keeps the length.
source:
/-- Insertion sort keeps the length. -/
theorem length_insertionSort (l : List α) : (insertionSort l).length = l.length :=
  (insertionSort_perm l).length_eq

name: Maithic.Algo.mem_insertionSort
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] {x : α} {l : List α},
  x ∈ Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l ↔ x ∈ l
doc: Insertion sort keeps the elements.
source:
/-- Insertion sort keeps the elements. -/
theorem mem_insertionSort {x : α} {l : List α} : x ∈ insertionSort l ↔ x ∈ l :=
  (insertionSort_perm l).mem_iff

name: Maithic.Algo.insertionSort_of_sorted
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] {l : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted l → Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l = l
doc: Sorting a sorted list changes nothing.
source:
/-- Sorting a sorted list changes nothing. -/
theorem insertionSort_of_sorted {l : List α} (h : Sorted l) : insertionSort l = l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx := sorted_cons.mp h
    simp only [insertionSort, ih hx.2]
    cases xs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons y ys => simp [insertSorted, hx.1 y (List.mem_cons_self ..)]
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx := sorted_cons.mp h
    simp only [insertionSort, ih hx.2]
    cases xs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons y ys => simp [insertSorted, hx.1 y (List.mem_cons_self ..)]

name: Maithic.Algo.insertionSort_idem
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] [Maithic.Algo.TotalPreorder α] (l : List α),
  Maithic.Algo.insertionSort (Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l) = Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l
doc: Insertion sort is idempotent.
source:
/-- Insertion sort is idempotent. -/
theorem insertionSort_idem [TotalPreorder α] (l : List α) :
    insertionSort (insertionSort l) = insertionSort l :=
  insertionSort_of_sorted (sorted_insertionSort l)

name: Maithic.Algo.linearSearch
type: {α : Type u} → [BEq α] → α → List α → Option Nat
doc: The index of the first element equal to `x`, if there is one.
source:
/-- The index of the first element equal to `x`, if there is one. -/
def linearSearch (x : α) : List α → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | y :: ys => if y == x then some 0 else (linearSearch x ys).map (· + 1)
proof:
| [] => none
  | y :: ys => if y == x then some 0 else (linearSearch x ys).map (· + 1)

name: Maithic.Algo.linearSearch_some
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α} {i : Nat},
  Maithic.Algo.linearSearch x l = some i → l[i]? = some x
doc: A returned index is in bounds and holds the target.
source:
/-- A returned index is in bounds and holds the target. -/
theorem linearSearch_some [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α} {i : Nat}
    (h : linearSearch x l = some i) : l[i]? = some x := by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp [linearSearch] at h
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hyx
      have hi : i = 0 := by simpa using h.symm
      subst hi
      simpa using hyx
    · cases hrec : linearSearch x ys with
      | none => simp [hrec] at h
      | some j =>
        have hi : i = j + 1 := by simpa [hrec] using h.symm
        subst hi
        simpa using ih hrec
proof:
by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp [linearSearch] at h
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hyx
      have hi : i = 0 := by simpa using h.symm
      subst hi
      simpa using hyx
    · cases hrec : linearSearch x ys with
      | none => simp [hrec] at h
      | some j =>
        have hi : i = j + 1 := by simpa [hrec] using h.symm
        subst hi
        simpa using ih hrec

name: Maithic.Algo.linearSearch_first
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α} {i j : Nat},
  Maithic.Algo.linearSearch x l = some i → j < i → l[j]? ≠ some x
doc: No element before a returned index equals the target.
source:
/-- No element before a returned index equals the target. -/
theorem linearSearch_first [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α} {i j : Nat}
    (h : linearSearch x l = some i) (hj : j < i) : l[j]? ≠ some x := by
  induction l generalizing i j with
  | nil => simp [linearSearch] at h
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · have hi : i = 0 := by simpa using h.symm
      omega
    · rename_i hyx
      cases hrec : linearSearch x ys with
      | none => simp [hrec] at h
      | some k =>
        have hi : i = k + 1 := by simpa [hrec] using h.symm
        subst hi
        cases j with
        | zero => simpa using hyx
        | succ j' => simpa using ih hrec (by omega)
proof:
by
  induction l generalizing i j with
  | nil => simp [linearSearch] at h
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · have hi : i = 0 := by simpa using h.symm
      omega
    · rename_i hyx
      cases hrec : linearSearch x ys with
      | none => simp [hrec] at h
      | some k =>
        have hi : i = k + 1 := by simpa [hrec] using h.symm
        subst hi
        cases j with
        | zero => simpa using hyx
        | succ j' => simpa using ih hrec (by omega)

name: Maithic.Algo.linearSearch_none
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.linearSearch x l = none → ¬x ∈ l
doc: `none` means the target does not occur.
source:
/-- `none` means the target does not occur. -/
theorem linearSearch_none [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α}
    (h : linearSearch x l = none) : x ∉ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · simp at h
    · rename_i hyx
      have hrec : linearSearch x ys = none := by simpa using h
      intro hmem
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with rfl | hmem
      · simp at hyx
      · exact ih hrec hmem
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · simp at h
    · rename_i hyx
      have hrec : linearSearch x ys = none := by simpa using h
      intro hmem
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with rfl | hmem
      · simp at hyx
      · exact ih hrec hmem

name: Maithic.Algo.linearSearch_isSome_iff
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α},
  (Maithic.Algo.linearSearch x l).isSome = true ↔ x ∈ l
doc: The search succeeds exactly when the target occurs.
source:
/-- The search succeeds exactly when the target occurs. -/
theorem linearSearch_isSome_iff [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α} :
    (linearSearch x l).isSome ↔ x ∈ l := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hs : linearSearch x l with
    | none => simp [hs] at h
    | some i => exact List.mem_of_getElem? (linearSearch_some hs)
  · intro hmem
    cases hs : linearSearch x l with
    | none => exact absurd hmem (linearSearch_none hs)
    | some i => rfl
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hs : linearSearch x l with
    | none => simp [hs] at h
    | some i => exact List.mem_of_getElem? (linearSearch_some hs)
  · intro hmem
    cases hs : linearSearch x l with
    | none => exact absurd hmem (linearSearch_none hs)
    | some i => rfl

name: Maithic.Algo.TotalPreorder
type: (α : Type u) → [LE α] → Prop
doc: The order facts that sorting needs: any two elements are comparable, and `≤` is transitive.
source:
/-- The order facts that sorting needs: any two elements are comparable, and `≤` is transitive. -/
class TotalPreorder (α : Type u) [LE α] : Prop where
  le_total : ∀ a b : α, a ≤ b ∨ b ≤ a
  le_trans : ∀ a b c : α, a ≤ b → b ≤ c → a ≤ c

name: Maithic.Algo.instTotalPreorderNat
type: Maithic.Algo.TotalPreorder Nat
source: instance : TotalPreorder Nat := ⟨Nat.le_total, fun _ _ _ => Nat.le_trans⟩

name: Maithic.Algo.instTotalPreorderInt
type: Maithic.Algo.TotalPreorder Int
source: instance : TotalPreorder Int := ⟨Int.le_total, fun _ _ _ => Int.le_trans⟩

name: Maithic.Algo.Sorted
type: {α : Type u} → [LE α] → List α → Prop
doc: A list is sorted when each element is at most every later element.
source:
/-- A list is sorted when each element is at most every later element. -/
def Sorted (l : List α) : Prop := l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

name: Maithic.Algo.SortedArray
type: {α : Type u} → [LE α] → Array α → Prop
doc: An array is sorted when its list of elements is.
source:
/-- An array is sorted when its list of elements is. -/
def SortedArray (a : Array α) : Prop := Sorted a.toList

name: Maithic.Algo.instDecidableSortedOfDecidableLE
type: {α : Type u} → [inst : LE α] → [DecidableLE α] → (l : List α) → Decidable (Maithic.Algo.Sorted l)
source:
instance [DecidableLE α] (l : List α) : Decidable (Sorted l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)))

name: Maithic.Algo.instDecidableSortedArrayOfDecidableLE
type:
{α : Type u} →
  [inst : LE α] → [DecidableLE α] → (a : Array α) → Decidable (Maithic.Algo.SortedArray a)
source:
instance [DecidableLE α] (a : Array α) : Decidable (SortedArray a) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (Sorted a.toList))

name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α], Maithic.Algo.Sorted []
source: @[simp] theorem sorted_nil : Sorted ([] : List α) := List.Pairwise.nil

name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_singleton
type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] (a : α), Maithic.Algo.Sorted [a]
source:
@[simp] theorem sorted_singleton (a : α) : Sorted [a] := by
  simp [Sorted]

name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_cons
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] {a : α} {l : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted (a :: l) ↔ (∀ (b : α), b ∈ l → a ≤ b) ∧ Maithic.Algo.Sorted l
doc:
A list with a new head is sorted exactly when the head is at most every element and the tail
is sorted.
source:
/-- A list with a new head is sorted exactly when the head is at most every element and the tail
is sorted. -/
theorem sorted_cons {a : α} {l : List α} : Sorted (a :: l) ↔ (∀ b ∈ l, a ≤ b) ∧ Sorted l :=
  List.pairwise_cons

name: Maithic.Algo.Sorted.tail
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] {a : α} {l : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted (a :: l) → Maithic.Algo.Sorted l
doc: The tail of a sorted list is sorted.
source:
/-- The tail of a sorted list is sorted. -/
theorem Sorted.tail {a : α} {l : List α} (h : Sorted (a :: l)) : Sorted l :=
  (sorted_cons.mp h).2

name: Maithic.Algo.Sorted.head_le
type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] {a b : α} {l : List α}, Maithic.Algo.Sorted (a :: l) → b ∈ l → a ≤ b
doc: The head of a sorted list is at most every later element.
source:
/-- The head of a sorted list is at most every later element. -/
theorem Sorted.head_le {a b : α} {l : List α} (h : Sorted (a :: l)) (hb : b ∈ l) : a ≤ b :=
  (sorted_cons.mp h).1 b hb

name: Maithic.Algo.Sorted.sublist
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] {l₁ l₂ : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted l₂ → l₁.Sublist l₂ → Maithic.Algo.Sorted l₁
doc: Any sublist of a sorted list is sorted.
source:
/-- Any sublist of a sorted list is sorted. -/
theorem Sorted.sublist {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : Sorted l₂) (hs : l₁.Sublist l₂) : Sorted l₁ :=
  List.Pairwise.sublist hs h

name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_append
type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] {l₁ l₂ : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted (l₁ ++ l₂) ↔
    Maithic.Algo.Sorted l₁ ∧ Maithic.Algo.Sorted l₂ ∧ ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l₁ → ∀ (b : α), b ∈ l₂ → a ≤ b
doc:
Two sorted lists concatenate to a sorted list when everything in the first is at most
everything in the second.
source:
/-- Two sorted lists concatenate to a sorted list when everything in the first is at most
everything in the second. -/
theorem sorted_append {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    Sorted (l₁ ++ l₂) ↔ Sorted l₁ ∧ Sorted l₂ ∧ ∀ a ∈ l₁, ∀ b ∈ l₂, a ≤ b :=
  List.pairwise_append
